title: Pair-Defensive Silver Colourings of Hypercubes
summary: A silver colouring is a proper colouring in which every colour appears in the closed neighbourhood of each vertex of a prescribed independent set. This local condition suffices when vertices are tested one at a time. We study a stronger requirement for simultaneous testing: whenever one or two vertices of the independent set are attacked together, each colour must supply distinct nearby defenders for them.
